title.narrative: Programme for Social, Political and Environmental Resilience (PROSPERIS)

description.narrative:
The program aims to address socio-economic, political and environmental vulnerabilities in Somalia to build resilience, increase trust in authorities and support long-term stabilization efforts.
The planned PROSPERIS program interventions are organized into four different thematic areas/component where each theme has specific types of interventions and activities: I. Socioeconomic component – covers activities focused on youth empowerment and engagement through sports (NETS) and Employment creation and livelihood opportunities. II. Political component (government visibility/presence) includes activities focused on rehabilitation/construction of government/public infrastructure facilities and technical support to relevant political and public institutions. III. Environmental component covers activities directed to promote water resource and renewable energy infrastructure development. IV. Cross Cutting component – will focus on issues including Monitoring and Evaluation, facilitation of strategic communication for government authorities and community engagement.
